text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm hurrying across the<n>plaza to make
it to my next meeting<n>on time...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Rawr! The sinister Windy appears<n>from beneath the
earth!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How was that?! Bet it scared ya!<n>Shakin' in your
boots, right?
choice_data_list: Sorry, but I need to get to a meeting!
Sorry, but I need to get to a meeting!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Eh? What?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-hey! What the heck was that boring<n>reaction?!
Oh, howdy, Windy! What's up?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm?! Oh, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, I'm finally back in my office<n>after finishing
the meeting and a<n>number of other errands.
choice_data_list: I think I'll take a quick break...

text_block_list.name: Windy and Taiki
text_block_list.text:
Help us! You're never gonna believe<n>what's
happened, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We've found ourselves up the creek<n>with no
paddle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I slammed right into Taiki and then we<n>switched
bodies! Growl!
choice_data_list: You what?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy?
text_block_list.text:
We're not yankin' yer chain—I mean,<n>this isn't a
prank! You gotta believe<n>us! Growl!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
She's right, we're not plotting<n>anything diabol—gah!
Uhh, I'm so<n>darned stumped!
choice_data_list: We need to get you to the hospital, quick!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text: What?! No! We can't!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text: I mean! Heavens, there's no need for<n>none of that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy?
text_block_list.text:
Growl! That's right! We already<n>found a way to get
back to normal!<n>But we need your help with it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what's going on, but I<n>can't leave
them like this, so I decide<n>to follow their instructions.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
We just need to repeat the conditions<n>that led to
our lil' switcheroo!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy?
text_block_list.text:
This happened 'cause we were<n>runnin' in the
hallway and smacked<n>into each other, so we just
gotta do<n>that again in the exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Sounds dandy, partner! Trainer, we'll<n>need you to
pass between us, just<n>like earlier!
choice_data_list: Isn't that dangerous?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Neeheehee! Just load the wagon,<n>Trainer! We'll
take care not to slam<n>into ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll be a monkey's uncle! This<n>ain't workin'
in a hurry, is it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy?
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I know! We should try eatin' each<n>other's
favorite food next! That'll do<n>the trick for sure!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text: Droool! Nice idea! I could use a big ol'slab of beef jerky right now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Whispers tell me there's some sweet<n>candy here
in the director's office<n>that can fix anythin'. Let's
hurry<n>and—
choice_data_list: I don't think that's a good idea!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Who's there? You can't just<n>barge into this
office!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them continue to lead me<n>this way and
that, leaving me with<n>quite a bit of apologizing to do
along<n>the way, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... Not a thing we've tried seems<n>to be workin'.
This is a real<n>head-scratcher, don'tcha reckon,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's something not quite right<n>about the way
she's been talking this<n>whole time. I think I know
what's<n>going on, so there's just one thing<n>left to
try.
choice_data_list: Ohh, this is awful! What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle?
text_block_list.text: Aha. Hmmm... Heh! Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Windy and Taiki
text_block_list.text: MWAAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Our prank was a grand success!<n>Trainer fell for it,
hook and sinker!
choice_data_list: (I knew it!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yessiree! Try not to get too riled up<n>though! There's
a mighty fine reason<n>for what we did.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So that's what's goin' on. No<n>wonder you're
feelin' so low!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah! It was no fun at all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Trainer's dumbstruck face is<n>always the
funniest part! Without that,<n>what's the point in even
playing any<n>pranks?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I reckon I know what you mean.<n>Must've been a
real letdown gettin'<n>no reaction.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How about you and I work together,<n>then? We can
think up somethin'<n>impossible to ignore!
choice_data_list: (So that's what happened...)
(So that's what happened...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We got a decent reaction outta ya this<n>time, so
we'll call it there! But I hope<n>you've learned your
lesson!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you don't take my pranks<n>seriously, then I'll
make sure to<n>prepare even nastier stuff for ya next
time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Watch yourself from now on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd have liked Shinko Windy to<n>express her
feelings more honestly,<n>but I suppose this is just
how she is.<n>I resolve to play along better in the
future.
choice_data_list: Bring it anytime!
Bring it anytime!
I'll work on the speed of my reactions.
I'll work on the speed of my reactions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd have liked Shinko Windy to<n>express her
feelings more honestly,<n>but I suppose this is just
how she is.<n>I resolve to play along better in the
future.
choice_data_list: Bring it anytime!
Bring it anytime!
I'll work on the speed of my reactions.
I'll work on the speed of my reactions.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You asked for it! I'mma start setting<n>up pranks
around the clock for ya<n>now.
choice_data_list: I've got the stamina to take it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrgh, but you don't got more than I<n>do!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Y'all sure get along mighty<n>fine!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? My next prank'll hit you so<n>fast, you
won't even know what<n>happened!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I declare! Won't that mean<n>you'll get no
reaction?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Eh?! That's no good!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer. Don't worry about<n>being speedy,
just make sure you<n>take the bait like you should,
capisce?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'll need to steel myself for<n>even more of
Shinko Windy's pranks<n>in the future.
